## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `ceb7b297f8394167fb6801e4714901d18c056595`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card objectui#6349 (body and all 29 comments, the batch 7 claim `6088763852`, the dev report `6089402631` and the amendment `6089430007` included), PR objectui#12071 (body, 12-file list, the net diff against `main` at this head: one commit on `e391f876`, which is the `main` tip, ahead 1 / behind 0, mergeable clean), and the 43 check-runs on this head. Reads only: `gh api` REST and `git show` / `git grep` against the fetched base and head refs. Nothing built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

Each accept-set and public-surface change the diff implies, read off the diff and the head tree, with my own census of in-repo readers at base.

1. **`@object-ui/plugin-grid` root: `AggregationConfig` leaves, `GroupAggregationConfig` arrives, members identical** — RIGHT. `useGroupedData.ts:26-31` at head declares `GroupAggregationConfig { field: string; type: AggregationType }`, the same two members the old interface carried; `index.tsx:53` publishes the new name in the old one's slot. The two meanings share only `field` (types' `AggregationConfig` in `data-protocol.ts:416` is the query-AST aggregation with `function`, `alias`, `distinct`, `separator`), so a re-point would have retyped the grid's `type` key, which its runtime reads. Renaming the narrower side and keeping the general name on `@object-ui/types` is batch 3's rule (`5548770074`) and the shape batches 4–6 landed. Accept set: an external `import type { AggregationConfig } from '@object-ui/plugin-grid'` stops compiling (TS2724 names the replacement); authored `object-grid.aggregations` entries are accepted unchanged. Census at base: no TS source imports `AggregationConfig` from the plugin-grid root or from `./useGroupedData` beyond the two changed files, and the only prose reader was the README line this PR edits. `ServerGroupHeadersInput` is not on the grid root; its `aggregations` member keeps the same shape.

2. **`@object-ui/plugin-kanban`: the module-local alias `ConditionalFormattingRule = KanbanConditionalFormattingRule` in `KanbanImpl.tsx` is deleted; nothing published moves** — RIGHT. The exports map has only `.` and `./style.css`; the entry `index.tsx` re-exports nothing from `./KanbanImpl` and reaches it only through a `React.lazy` dynamic import in `KanbanBoardCore.tsx`; `KanbanRendererProps.conditionalFormatting` already spelled `KanbanConditionalFormattingRule` at base. So the alias published nothing, and its five uses now spell the specific name the authority already declares (`objectql.ts`). `KanbanBoardProps.conditionalFormatting` is the same type as before. DELETE branch, no new name coined: right, the narrower meaning already had its own name. At head the only remaining mentions in the package are the explanatory comment and a historical CHANGELOG line.

3. **`@object-ui/plugin-list` root: `ViewType` leaves, no replacement export on this root** — RIGHT. Base `index.tsx:28` published `ViewSwitcherProps, ViewType`; head publishes `ViewSwitcherProps` only. `ViewSwitcherProps.currentView` / `availableViews` / `onViewChange` and `ListViewProps.onViewChange` are now typed on `@object-ui/core`'s `ListViewVisualization`, the same nine-member union the alias named, so their published shapes are unchanged; `VIEW_ICONS` and `VIEW_LABEL_KEYS` stay total over that union, so the exhaustiveness guard still fires on the next spec visualization. Accept set: `import type { ViewType } from '@object-ui/plugin-list'` stops compiling (TS2305). The migration target is real: `ListViewVisualization` is declared at `packages/core/src/utils/normalize-list-view.ts:208` and reaches the core root through `export * from './utils/normalize-list-view.js'` (`packages/core/src/index.ts:155`). Not re-exporting it from plugin-list is right: a second export site would be exactly the aliasing re-export the gate counts (the dev's F3 leg lit on it). Re-pointing at types' 11-member `ViewType` was rightly refused: it makes both total maps incomplete, and filling them needs icons and labels for `list` and `detail`, a runtime change off the claim. Census at base: the only importers of `ViewType` from `./ViewSwitcher` were `ListView.tsx` and the barrel, both changed; no file in the repo imports `ViewType` from `@object-ui/plugin-list` (CHANGELOG and ROADMAP prose are records, not readers); no docs page or README names it.

4. **Ledger: `KNOWN_COLLISIONS` 19 rows at base, 16 at head** — RIGHT, counted on both files. The three removed rows are exactly `AggregationConfig`, `ConditionalFormattingRule` and `ViewType`; the other sixteen names are unchanged, the Filter rows and `CalendarEvent` among them. Each removed row is replaced by a comment naming the branch taken.

5. **`@object-ui/types` and `@object-ui/core` untouched; the general names stay on `types`** — RIGHT. No file under `packages/types` or `packages/core` is in the 12-file list; at head the only `AggregationConfig` / `ConditionalFormattingRule` / `ViewType` declarations under `packages/` are the three authority sites.

6. **Types and comments only; no emitted JavaScript moves** — RIGHT. Every hunk is a type name, a type declaration, a comment, a changeset or the README line; no value-level code changes. Bundle Analysis is success on the head and the console eager-closure budget reads PASS.

7. **Fences held** — RIGHT. No `packages/components/src/ui/**`, no `packages/i18n/**`, no runtime behaviour, no other ledger row. Governed Surface Queue Guard is success.

8. **PR shape** — RIGHT. Draft; first line `Refs #6349 (batch 7)`; no closing keyword (scanned the body: none); the `Clause-②: yes` line at line start; one commit; no angle bracket in the body.

**Check-runs on this head (the gate verdicts):** 43 runs, 40 success, 3 skipped (dependabot, Test (coverage), Test (coverage shard): the expected three), 0 failure. Type Check, Lint, Test shards 1–8 plus the Test aggregate, Test (dist pins), Build & E2E, Build Docs, Doc Snippet Type Check, README Export Check, Changeset Declaration, Changeset Bump Policy, Changeset Fixed Group Check, Changeset Claim Re-read, Changeset Overwrite Report, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Spec Main Shape Gate, Line Citation Gate, Control Byte Scan and Bundle Analysis all read success. The legacy Vercel status is success. The one-authority gate runs under the Test shards; the dev's seven ablation legs (three stale, three fresh, one control, each restore proven) are the non-vacuity evidence, read and not re-run.

### ② Semver level

- **`Clause-②: yes` — RIGHT.** Two published names leave package roots (`AggregationConfig` from plugin-grid, `ViewType` from plugin-list) and one arrives (`GroupAggregationConfig`).
- **`6349-batch7-plugin-grid.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-grid` `minor`, breaking note with the migration — RIGHT.** A published name leaves and its replacement arrives; the note names `GroupAggregationConfig`, the unchanged members and the TS2724 hint.
- **`6349-batch7-plugin-list.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-list` `minor`, breaking note naming `ListViewVisualization` from `@object-ui/core` — RIGHT.** A published name leaves; the named replacement is on the core root (item 3 of ① above).
- **`6349-batch7-plugin-kanban.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-kanban` `patch` — RIGHT.** The deleted alias reached no entry; nothing published moves.
- **No changeset for `types`, `core` or `plugin-view` — RIGHT.** None is touched.
- The three grades are the ones the amendment `6089430007` fixed per package; none is `major` (Changeset Bump Policy success). Changeset Declaration is success on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **open_questions[0] — is `GroupAggregationConfig` on the plugin-grid root covered by the claim?** Answered by the amendment `6089430007`: A (B as the record). The diff does exactly that: the new name takes the old one's slot on the root, nothing else is added. Right.
- **Deviation: `packages/plugin-grid/README.md` outside the named surface.** Answered by the same amendment, which accepted the file; README Export Check is success on the head. Right.
- **Deviation: two prose lines in the gate file outside `KNOWN_COLLISIONS` ("the contested name" to "the bare name", the header JSDoc and one fixture comment).** Judged acceptable here: comment-only, in the file the claim already places on the surface for the row removals; the near-spelling fixtures themselves are unchanged; batch 5's declared fixture-comment line was accepted the same way (`6079810246`). No escalation.
- **Deviation: JSDoc and comments at the changed sites, each saying why the general name is not used.** Comment-only, in claim files. Acceptable.
- **Deviation: commit trailers are the repo's model-free pair.** The one commit matches the shape batches 4–6 landed with. Acceptable.
- **Deviation: not run locally** — the full app-shell suite (covered: Test shards 1–8 and the Test aggregate are success), the type-checks of app-shell, the console and the other dependants (covered: Type Check is success), the i18n gates (no locale pack in the file list). Each is answered by a passing check-run on this head.
- **Deviations: type-checks re-run after the commit; worktree removed.** Housekeeping, acceptable.
- **out_of_scope_findings (both noted, not filed):** `GroupAggregationConfig` restates the inline element type of `ObjectGridSchema.aggregations` (a structural copy, not a name collision under the gate), and types' grid and kanban rule names differ only by the retired tombstone. Neither is a defect under the gate; nothing to answer.
- **Tier notice `5612085492`** lifted this card's contract-review-tier requirement; the seat runs the review at the ceiling because of the `Clause-②: yes` line, as it did for batches 4–6. Noted, no conflict.
- **Reviewer observation, noted and not filed (no gate reads it):** `packages/plugin-list/src/ViewSwitcher.tsx:74` still says "the same glyph for the same `ViewType`". After this PR the bare name inside plugin-list means types' wider vocabulary, so "visualization" is the precise word. A one-word comment rider for a later batch on this card; not a reason to re-run CI now.
